raw_response:
I farm 21.4 mu, and I will still lean on the same pattern that has kept land steady here: wheat-maize as the backbone, then smaller blocks for chili and cotton to bring cash. I will not spread money evenly just for the sake of it. I will put the stronger fertilizer and more water on chili because that crop pays only if fruit sets well and keeps picking. Wheat and maize are my base crops, so I will keep their fertilizer rates close to what I have seen work in our area, and I will not cut nitrogen too hard because losing yield costs more than wasting a little fertilizer. Cotton I will keep on a smaller area, because my family has only 2 people and cotton takes more watching and more hand work at harvest. Since I have well irrigation, I will use water at the key times instead of gambling on rain. For tillage, I will save labor where I can: maize after wheat I will do with less soil movement, but the chili land I will turn deeper so the base fertilizer goes down and roots run better.
